## About this app

Pocket Fit is an AI-powered fitness app that acts as your personal digital trainer, helping you log workouts quickly, create smart, personalized workout plans, and track your progress. It adapts each workout to your body, schedule, and available equipment, ensuring efficient training whether at home, the gym, or on the go. The app offers workout logging, AI-generated exercise suggestions, progress analytics, and smart scheduling to keep you consistent and motivated. Perfect for all fitness levels, Pocket Fit simplifies fitness training with dynamic, adaptive programs that grow with you. This makes it ideal for busy users seeking personalized and injury-friendly workouts.

Your personal trainer in your pocket
